title: PRISMA [Bedrock] Shader Pack
shortDesc: A colorful Minecraft Bedrock texture pack designed around a vibrant prism-themed visual style with redesigned GUI and controls.
fullReview:
PRISMA is a colorful Minecraft Bedrock texture pack designed around a vibrant prism-themed visual style. It gives Minecraft a fresh and eye-catching appearance with bright colors, pink and purple tones, and a redesigned interface.

The pack focuses mainly on the game's visual interface rather than completely replacing every Minecraft texture. It includes a redesigned Start Screen, Settings Screen, buttons, GUI, hotbar, and different control layouts for mobile players.

One of the strongest points of PRISMA is its consistent visual style. The colorful interface combined with the redesigned HUD gives Minecraft a much more unique and modern feeling while keeping the basic Minecraft gameplay familiar.

Performance:
Because PRISMA is a 16x texture/UI pack, it is relatively lightweight compared with high-resolution texture packs. It can be a good option for players who want a colorful visual upgrade without using an extremely heavy texture pack.

Rating: 8.5/10
creator: znygames
features: Multiple control layouts (Joystick, D-Pad, Tap controls)
Lightweight 16x resolution optimized for mobile devices

title: IRRITATOR DWELLER
shortDesc: A horror-focused Minecraft Bedrock add-on introducing a terrifying cave-dwelling creature with unique AI, attacks, and dynamic thunderstorm effects.
fullReview:
IRRITATOR DWELLER is a horror-focused Minecraft Bedrock add-on designed to make survival much more tense and unpredictable. It introduces a terrifying cave-dwelling creature with unique animations, attacks, and improved AI, creating a much darker atmosphere while exploring underground areas.

The add-on focuses on making the Dweller feel like a serious threat rather than just another ordinary Minecraft mob. Its appearance, animations, and behavior are designed to create a creepy atmosphere, especially when exploring dark caves.

One of the most interesting features is the improved thunderstorm system. Thunderstorms include more atmospheric sounds and bright flashes in the sky, making bad weather feel much more intense.

Gameplay:
The IRRITATOR DWELLER can appear in caves during Survival. Only one creature can exist in the world at a time, making encounters less frequent but more unpredictable. It can also hang upside down when there are blocks above it, allowing it to blend into dark cave areas.

The creature has several different attacks, including normal hand attacks, a roar that knocks the player back, and a powerful leap attack. The add-on is mainly designed around atmosphere and survival tension rather than giving players unique loot.

Rating: 9/10
creator: OvertRegularity13
features: Terrifying IRRITATOR DWELLER mob with improved AI
Multiple attack types (Hand attack, Knockback Roar, Powerful Leap)
Unique ceiling-hanging animations for dark caves
Enhanced thunderstorm effects with white sky flashes
experimentalNote: Turn on Holiday Creator Features and Custom Mobs in World Settings.

changes: Added Dweller AI and custom atmospheric thunderstorm visuals
